text: Calibrate autonomy benchmark resource budgets with excluded pilot runs
description: Run a non-confirmatory calibration set over the four v2 fixtures to estimate authoritative token and wall-time distributions before any v3 preregistration. Label every record pilot-only and prohibit use in capability or efficiency scoring. Use gpt-5.6-sol, identical least-authority isolation, one stateless run per task, generous 200000-token/180000-ms capture limits, no retries, and preserve failures. Report observed max and a conservative proposed v3 per-run budget derived by a rule fixed before launch: ceiling(max observed tokens * 1.25 to nearest 10000) and ceiling(max observed wall time * 1.5 to nearest 30000), capped at 250000 tokens/240000 ms. Do not run graph-grounded treatment or a confirmatory comparison in this aim.

reflections.context: Ran the predeclared pilot-only calibration: one stateless gpt-5.6-sol execution per v2 fixture, 200000-token/180000-ms capture caps, no retries, and no treatment runs.
reflections.outcome: All 4/4 pilots independently verified with zero interventions and policy violations. Records: checkpoint migration 100580 tokens/52007 ms/5 tools; contradictory evidence 85649/27312/4; stale reconciliation 133338/45837/6; policy feature 104069/42838/5. Maxima were 133338 tokens and 52007 ms. The fixed rounding rule proposes v3 limits of 170000 tokens and 90000 ms.
reflections.effectiveness: Calibration explained v2's invalidity: three of four pilot token usages exceeded the former 100000 cap, including one by only 580. It provides a prospective budget without reusing or rescoring v2 evidence. All records remain pilot-only.
reflections.lesson: Model token usage varies materially even on deterministic small fixtures; calibrate confirmatory caps prospectively with explicit exclusion labels and headroom.
reflections.pattern: Separate budget-estimation pilots from treatment comparisons and derive limits by a frozen formula.

supportingConnections.explanation: Freezes the exact limits derived by its excluded pilot rule.

status.comment: Four excluded calibration pilots completed safely; prospective v3 limits derived as 170000 tokens and 90000 ms. Awaiting user acceptance.

valueRationale: Prospective budget calibration is required to avoid another structurally invalid comparison while keeping confirmatory evidence independent.
